wall.label: Bored next to a wall: where does it walk after its first search?
wall.explanation: After searching at (35,2) the counts of (34..36, 1..3) are 5. With #146 alone the score reads each candidate's north-west neighbour: (34,2) is scored with (33,1)'s 0, so the Borg steps west onto a grid it has just covered, searches it again, and repeats: six searches, five on covered grids, in twelve calls. With both corrections (34,2) and (36,2) carry their own 5, so it walks to (37,2), which no search has covered, and continues to (39,2) and (41,2): four searches, none repeated. The pristine source searches its own grid three times and never moves.
